section.p: Disabled by default, the Wi-Fi option (on factory configured WLAN-enabled models) can be enabled and configured to attach as a Client to an already established IEEE 802.11 access point and network, or configured as an Access Point to establish a new network. In addition, when configured as an Access Point, the controller can be set to "Off" or one of three active modes - using the Switch Position property in . Refer to the WiFi Configuration topic for more details about configuration options.
section.note: Dynamic Frequency Selection (DFS) channels are not supported.
